title: Notifications arrive twice
body: Every notification shows up twice in the bell menu.

title: Notifications de-duplicated by id
body:
> Bugfix for Bug #219.

## Diagnosis

Command: `node scripts/notify.js --seed fixtures/dup.json`
Root cause: the bell menu appends every delivery event instead of upserting by notification id (`src/notify/render.js:41`).

## Acceptance criteria

```gherkin
Feature: Notifications are not duplicated

  Scenario: A redelivered notification does not appear twice
    Given a notification already shown once
    When the same notification is redelivered
    Then the bell menu still shows it once
```

## Implementation notes

- Seam: `src/notify/render.js`, dedupe by notification id before appending to the list.
